content.short: Sunflower Land is a crypto farming game where players build their farming empires.
content.description: Sunflower Land is a crypto farming game where players cultivate crops, collect resources, and expand and decorate their land to build a thriving farming empire. It provides digital ownership and property rights for in-game assets. As an open-source project, its community consists of over 200 artists and developers who actively contribute to the game's development, giving players a meaningful voice and a higher level of control over their gaming experience.
